reviewed_by: Claude #1097 parity implementer; defects independently validated by a separate Claude validator (issues/parity/validation.md, real-Core terminal probe); an independent diff review is still required before merge
reason: Terminal parity for #1097. (1) The terminal Assistant now holds Core's #1101 project-view lease while it shows a project (PUT engagements/{id}/view-leases/{lease} with ttl_seconds 90, renewed on Core's 30 s hint, retried after 10 s on failure so a Core restart renews or recreates the same keyed lease), moves it when another project opens, and releases it (DELETE) on Core switch and on exit; without it a chatless project's Notes/Board reads stayed 503 'project is idle'. (2) /board track offered the terminal's placeholder title 'Conversation' because view.session is copied before Core names the chat; the track action now reads Core's current conversation title (falling back to the local copy), preserving the track:<session> request-key chain and Done-item reporting from #1067. Selected: the new lease unit file (hold/renew/same id/retry after 503/refusal/project switch/Core switch release), the shell file (startup + quit releases the lease), the board action file (Core title default, fallback, request-key chain), the client package file (new module is in the wheel allowlist) and a product-knowledge discovery check for the CLI.md guidance.
exclusions: No Core, API or GUI source changes: the lease routes and admission rules (#1101) are unchanged and covered by tests/v3/test_project_view_leases.py, which this diff does not touch. No frontend or native changes, so no frontend, native or Playwright selection. The PTY layout suite and other terminal files do not exercise the lease or /board track. Other *_knowledge files only re-read the regenerated product index.
